And here we go…GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are yours to make more games with.

Oh, and they’re also super efficient and really good at making slides, building websites, and tackling the work you were doing before you started making games.

highlights.excerpt:
Knowing things → doing things → finding ways to save you time and money

We’re expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions of people in six countries. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Tasks lets you hand off everyday life admin directly:

- Forward emails to gemini@google.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
从知道事情 → 去做事情 → 想办法帮你省时省钱

我们正在把 Gemini 中的 Tasks 免费扩展到六个国家的数亿用户。由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 驱动，Tasks 能让你直接把日常事务交出去：

- 把邮件转发到 gemini@google.com，即可回复邀请并加入家庭日历
- 让 Gemini 致电本地商家比较报价、查询库存（全程有文字记录，拨打前需你批准）
highlights.name: Sundar Pichai
highlights.text_zh: Pichai 宣布 Gemini Tasks 向六国数亿用户免费开放，可代办日程、询价并支持支付。

summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，官方介绍帖约 2.9 万赞。
Isomorphic Labs 获 50 亿美元融资；Perplexity 称 ARR 已破 10 亿美元。
话题上 GLM 智谱涨 48.2%、Codex 涨 35.5%；Gemini 与 Kimi 分别下跌。
topics_zh: 涨幅领先的是 GLM 智谱（+48.2%）、Codex（+35.5%）、Opus 5.5（+28.3%）和 Claude Code（+26.0%）；Gemini（-12.3%）与 Kimi（-14.9%）回落。
